name: Tensor Approximation
definition: A method approximating volume datasets using SVD/PCA-like tools, interpreting the volume as a tensor factorized into rank-one tensors (CP decomposition) or a core tensor and matrices (Tucker decomposition).
summary: Tensor Approximation compresses volume data by factorizing it into a core tensor and factor matrices, removing small-scale features while highlighting specific structural patterns unlike standard LOD reduction.
